title: Missing Lock Bit Protection in the Northbridge IO (NBIO) could allow a privileged attacker to use an intentionally…
description: CVE-2024-36309 describes a vulnerability involving missing lock bit protection in the Northbridge IO (NBIO) component. This flaw could allow a privileged attacker to exploit an intentionally disabled device through a remapping attack, potentially affecting data confidentiality, integrity, or availability. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.6. No specific affected software versions or patches are provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
